<img src="assets/section-about.svg" alt="About the explorer" width="100%">

I'm an Information Systems student at FAESA, in Vitória, Brazil, focused on backend development with Java and Spring Boot.

I learn a concept by building something that lets me watch it work. My two main projects do exactly that: one replays sorting algorithms step by step, the other shows an LRU cache deciding what to evict. I'm looking for an internship or junior role where I can keep building that way.

Beyond the backend, I use React and TypeScript for interfaces, and Python is also part of my toolbox.
